title: unified-rollouts-canary-shadow-ab-autorollback-enhancements
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Improve stability and observability of unified rollouts by tightening auto-rollback decision logic for canary/A-B and shadow traffic, add quorum-based metric matching and e2e stability guards, and surface new rollback telemetry in Console. Changes include operator safeguards to avoid cascading rollbacks, more conservative default thresholds, and a configurable quorum for noisy metrics. This PR touches the rollout engine, telemetry instrumentation, and adds integration/e2e tests. Checklist: - [x] Implement quorum metric matching in autorollback engine. - [x] Add safety window and cooldown for rollout stages. - [x] Emit per-stage rollback reasons and metric snapshots to telemetry. - [x] Add e2e test harness for staged canary + shadow scenarios. - [x] Update docs and runtime config defaults. Related: ENG-4821 outlines incident that motivated stricter rollback quorum, SUP-3142 customer report for flappy rollouts.

review_comments: Samir Gupta: Concerned about metric quorum defaults being too strict for low-traffic customers. Request: make quorum configurable and add a fallback if insufficient sample size.
Maya Patel: Reply: quorum is configurable via rollout.spec.observability.quorum and defaults to 3 in low-traffic mode. Added fallback to use aggregated composite metric when sample size < quorum.
Elena Rodriguez: Found race in staged shadow eviction path where two parallel checks could schedule a rollback twice. Suggestion: add stage-level mutex or idempotency guard.
Maya Patel: Reply: applied a stage-level idempotency token and added unit tests to cover parallel evaluation. See commit a7b8c9.
Ben Thompson: Please add an integration test that simulates noisy latency spikes to validate cooldown and stability guards before merge.
Maya Patel: Reply: added tests/integration/staged_shadow_canary_e2e.yaml and a test harness that injects synthetic noise. CI re-run included e2e job.
Samir Gupta: Approved after quorum default made configurable and telemetry fields documented.
ci_checks: integration-tests: fail on first run (flaky timeout) -> re-run passed
release_notes: Enhancement: tighter auto-rollback decision logic with quorum-based metric matching for canary/A-B/shadow rollouts.
Safety: stage-level idempotency guards and rollout cooldown windows to prevent cascading rollbacks.
Observability: Emit per-stage rollback reasons and metric snapshots to Console for easier debugging.
Tests: added e2e harness for staged canary + shadow scenarios to catch regression flakiness.
